briefTitle: Phase 2 Study for the Patient, Who Has Diagnosed With Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) or Non Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) or Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC) and Finished the First Line Stand Treatment , Need More Treatment

typedChecks.sourceText: Male or female, 18 years of age or older
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Male or female, 18 years of age or older

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial enrolls multiple cancer types (SCLC, NSCLC, RCC) and does not specify NSCLC stage or a single clean histology subset.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have at least 1 lesion that meets the criteria for being measurable, as defined by RECIST 1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a life expectancy of at least 3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.
